summary: Platåberget 测试网激活 Glamsterdam，但升级过渡时的构建者存款缓存问题导致无法最终确定；晚上 ACDC #185 提议 Sepolia 9 月 28 日、Hoodi 10 月 26 日升级。账户侧，chunter-cb 把 EIP-8130 的认证器分为 CANONICAL、PURE、BOUNDED、ARBITRARY 四级，用于内存池传播而不改变共识有效性；AnkushinDaniil 为不批准的验证前缀给出出块方重执行上限。EF 形式化验证团队上线 better.codes 自动研究挑战。

items.topic: 原生 AA 的内存池与 gas 语义
items.title: EIP-8130：四级认证器分类
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交。把原来的规范/宽松二分改为按代码哈希分类的 CANONICAL、PURE、BOUNDED、ARBITRARY 四级；共识有效性不变，L1 档位下任何在 `MAX_AUTHENTICATION_GAS` 内返回的认证器在区块中仍有效，分级只决定内存池传播和重新验证。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: add a four-tier authenticator classification
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted. It replaces the binary canonical/permissive description with four tiers, CANONICAL, PURE, BOUNDED and ARBITRARY, that classify a declared authenticator by code hash; consensus validity is unchanged, and under the L1 profile any authenticator returning within `MAX_AUTHENTICATION_GAS` remains valid in a block, while the tiers govern mempool propagation and revalidation.

items.title: EIP-8141：在 frame 入口收取解析目标的访问费
items.note: （gurukamath）提交。规范说在 frame 自己的 `limits.execution` 内收取 `resolved_target` 的冷热访问费，却没说何时收，也没为默认代码 frame 定义执行成本，实现可能在 `gas_used.execution`、warm 状态乃至有效性上分歧。同作者的 把 APPROVE 失败模式限定在当前调用帧 同日提交。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: charge the resolved target's access at frame entry
items.note_en: (gurukamath), submitted. The spec charges a `resolved_target`'s warm/cold access within the frame's own `limits.execution` but never says when, and defines no execution cost for frames dispatched to the default code, so implementations can diverge on `gas_used.execution`, on warmth and even on validity. The same author's scope APPROVE failure modes to the current call frame was submitted the same day.

items.title: EIP-8141：约束出块方对不批准验证前缀的重执行
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。内存池一节已约束接收和换头时的重新验证，但没有约束出块方的重执行。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: bound producer-side re-execution of an unapproving validation prefix
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. The mempool section already bounds admission and head-change revalidation but not re-execution by the block producer.

items.title: EIP-8141：用 EIP-7976 统一 token 计数修正 calldata 底价
items.note: （ilitteri）提交。原公式按加权计数乘以 16，等于零字节 16 gas、非零字节 64 gas，既不符合 EIP-7623（10/40）也不符合 EIP-7976（64/64）。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: fix the calldata floor to use the EIP-7976 uniform token count
items.note_en: (ilitteri), submitted. The formula multiplied a weighted count by 16, which prices zero bytes at 16 gas and nonzero bytes at 64, matching neither EIP-7623 (10/40) nor EIP-7976 (64/64).

keywords_en: Sepolia September 28 and Hoodi October 26 proposal
EIP-8141 bound on validation prefix re-execution
summary_en: The Platåberget testnet activated Glamsterdam, but a builder deposit caching issue at the upgrade transition caused non-finality; in the evening ACDC #185 proposed upgrading Sepolia on September 28 and Hoodi on October 26. On accounts, chunter-cb split EIP-8130 authenticators into four tiers, CANONICAL, PURE, BOUNDED and ARBITRARY, which govern mempool propagation without changing consensus validity, and AnkushinDaniil proposed a bound on producer-side re-execution of non-approving validation prefixes. The EF Formal Verification team launched the better.codes autoresearch challenge.
